classification_is: Operational candidate scope based on pinned distribution provenance and observed historical documents; no warranty of rights and no general legal opinion

upstream_basis.interpretation: Official README explicitly points to preprocessed datasets for training and states an MIT project license. Together with the pinned HF distribution this is evidence of intended training use, not blanket authority over each upstream issue author, patch, or vendored component. A missing HF card field does not automatically invalidate this narrow local numeric pilot.

issue_text.interpretation: Current GitHub D.6 connects contributed content to a repository license and permits separate agreements to override. D.4 rights for GitHub and affiliates are not our rights. These current terms do not prove that every historical issue author accepted identical terms or had rights to included material. Apache sections 1 and 5 explicitly address intentional contributions through issue tracking, but intent, separate agreements, and exclusion notices remain possible exceptions. Keep the global unresolved flag while documenting narrow local candidate use; do not treat that single flag as a blanket all-row veto or blanket approval.

checkpoint.cost_label_note: Readiness still requires the cost-data join: valid targets, fully mapped old paths, finite label-free features, and successful rank/cost checks. License/root candidates are not training-example counts.

next_fit_candidate_rule: Freeze a per-task manifest before fitting that joins fixed development membership, pinned provenance, exact root digest, and verified document blob/SHA-256 evidence. Keep train/validation roles and all 13021 rows in coverage denominators; never read final outcomes.

Allow only the explicitly reviewed conditional_local_numeric_candidate subset for a private local original tiny head on generic 16 numeric features. Source corpus text, token/path vocabulary, task and repo IDs, patches, and query/path strings remain outside training tensors and published artifacts.

Keep unknown/missing, explicit restrictive EULA, and ambiguous file-scoped conditions pending before fitting. Do not choose exclusions using model scores or silently relabel unavailable examples as negatives.

Join source candidates to actual successful cost/feature rows independently. Bad patches, absent catalogs, partially mapped targets, ranking failures, and feature failures are separate readiness states.

No raw source redistribution, upstream-encoder fine-tuning, text generation, or public weight release follows from this local pilot classification. A public release needs its own actual-artifact and notice review.

Given only 107 catalog-backed validation candidates in this checkpoint, any fit is a partial local pilot. It cannot prove robustness on the protected 2402 final tasks or the full 5686 validation cohort.

exceptions.eula_summary: Alpha/Beta documents grant limited internal business use and impose copying, adaptation, publication/distribution restrictions, with proprietary/confidential language. Their software/documentation scope is not a proof about every issue author's text; it is an adverse historical condition that should not be ignored by automatically adopting the current Apache license.
exceptions.mixed_summary: 89 snapshots use /server Prefect Community conditions and Apache elsewhere; one uses src/prefect/server and a Version 0.0 Prefect agreement. These custom conditions include competing-online-service limitations and non-sublicensing. File headers may override stated defaults. The numerical metadata pilot may ultimately be separable, but this has not been shown for these task inputs, so keep them pending rather than assuming Apache covers all.
exceptions.next_evidence: To consider mixed rows later, predefine a numeric-metadata-only scope and verify target/file boundaries plus applicable header exceptions and issue-source provenance without inspecting model scores. Do not retroactively replace the historical license with a current permissive label.

exceptions.summary: No root or directly traversed license-directory candidate at those cached historical roots. This is not proof that no license exists anywhere. Keep those two pending; inspect pinned documentation/header or ancestor/source-origin evidence separately.

Root grants are BSD-3-Clause. Historical LICENSE-3rdparty.csv records include LGPL-3.0-only, LGPL-2.1-only and AFL-3.0, alongside permissive identifiers such as MIT and BSD. The CSV is an inventory, not a license grant for every component and not a rule automatically licensing original generic numeric weights under LGPL/AFL. This pilot does not ingest vendored code bodies; any future code copying/runtime linkage or public-derived release needs component-specific review.

Root BSD-3-Clause plus explicit bundled notices: PSF/CNRI/BeOpen/CWI histories, Apache, BSD, MIT, and OTHER with an additional numpydoc notice-path pointer. A GPL string in historical compatibility tables is not proof that the PSF file or pandas is GPL. Preserve separate notice evidence and do not equate a keyword hit with a license decision.

Observed root grants coexist with bundled third-party license/attribution notices. Treat the root classification as the narrow reviewed generic metadata pilot scope; preserve actual notice inventories and scope exceptions for copying or release.

notice_requirements.local_evidence: Preserve verified provenance, exact document hashes, copyright/notice inventories, and source exclusions privately. Public summaries may contain repo names, pinned public URLs, hashes and aggregate counts, not copied raw queries, paths, patches, or full upstream license text.
notice_requirements.mit: If distributing upstream software or substantial portions, retain its copyright and permission notice. Citation of SWE-bench provenance in a model card is also appropriate.
notice_requirements.apache_2: If distributing covered work/derivatives, retain license copy, applicable source notices and readable applicable NOTICE attribution, and mark modified files. The project name/logo does not imply endorsement.
notice_requirements.bsd: Covered redistribution must retain required copyright, conditions and disclaimers; binary distributions include them in documentation/materials, and the non-endorsement condition remains.
notice_requirements.original_numeric_model: Keep the model's own license separate from source-provenance notices. Do not assert automatic inheritance or automatic freedom merely because weights are small. Review actual array contents, vocabulary/raw-string absence, artifacts, upstream dependency/code inclusion, and disclosure metadata before publishing.

operational_conclusion: A concrete source-filtered private local numeric pilot subset can be advanced under policy41. The reviewed checkpoint yields 3172 catalog-backed candidates, subject to the cost/feature join. Known adverse or missing conditions remain 216 pending roots, unavailable roots remain 9632, historical issue grants remain globally unresolved, and public release remains separate.
